testable_claims: The numerical identity of a collection changed legitimately as different institutions and operations counted different units.
Physical receipt was a necessary but insufficient condition of institutional usability.
Competence, language, script, catalogue fields and classification were infrastructural variables in institutional legibility.
Later title lists can increase identifiability while simultaneously overwriting or correcting earlier descriptive states.
